title_en: Provisions on the Reporting of Tax-related Information by Internet Platform Enterprises

articles.content_en: Article 3 An internet platform enterprise shall, within 30 days from the date of coming into force of these Provisions or within 30 days from the date of commencing internet operation business, submit to its competent tax authority the platform domain name, business type, unified social credit code and name of the relevant operating entity, and other information.

Article 4 An internet platform enterprise shall, within the month following the end of each quarter, submit to its competent tax authority the identity information and income information of the previous quarter of operators and practitioners on the platform, in accordance with the specific categories and contents of identity information and income information prescribed by the competent tax authority under the State Council.
For practitioners engaging in convenient labor activities such as distribution, transportation, and housekeeping on the internet platform, if they enjoy tax incentives or are not required to pay tax according to law, the internet platform enterprise is not required to submit their income information. Where the internet platform enterprise has already filled in tax-related information when handling withholding declarations, agency declarations, or other tax-related matters for operators and practitioners on the platform in accordance with the provisions, such information shall not be submitted repeatedly.

Article 5 An internet platform enterprise shall submit tax-related information through the internet or other means in accordance with the data scope and standards for submission of tax-related information prescribed by the competent tax authority under the State Council.
The tax authority shall provide safe and reliable channels for submitting tax-related information, actively use modern information technology to provide interface services such as direct connection submission and upload import, and provide consulting services such as policy interpretation and problem solving.

Article 6 An internet platform enterprise shall verify the tax-related information of operators and practitioners on the platform and be responsible for its authenticity, accuracy, and completeness. The tax authority may, based on the needs of tax supervision, verify the tax-related information submitted by the internet platform enterprise. Where the internet platform enterprise has fulfilled its verification obligation for the submitted tax-related information, and the tax-related information is untrue, inaccurate, or incomplete due to the fault of the operator or practitioner on the platform, the internet platform enterprise shall not be held liable.

Article 7 When the tax authority conducts a tax inspection according to law or discovers tax-related risks, it may require the internet platform enterprise and relevant parties to provide tax-related information such as contract orders, transaction details, fund accounts, logistics, etc., of operators and practitioners on the platform suspected of illegal activities. The internet platform enterprise and relevant parties shall truthfully provide such information in accordance with the time limit, method, and content required by the tax authority.

Article 8 The departments of industry and information technology, human resources and social security, transportation, market supervision, and cyberspace administration shall strengthen the sharing of tax-related information with the tax authority. With respect to tax-related information that can be obtained through information sharing, the tax authority shall not require the internet platform enterprise to submit it repeatedly.

Article 9 An internet platform enterprise shall properly preserve the tax-related information of operators and practitioners on the platform in accordance with laws, administrative regulations, and relevant state provisions.
The tax authority shall keep the obtained tax-related information confidential according to law, establish a tax-related information security management system in accordance with laws, administrative regulations, and relevant state provisions, implement data security protection responsibilities, and ensure the security of tax-related information.

Article 11 Where the tax authority or its staff members commit illegal acts in the management of submission of tax-related information by internet platform enterprises, legal liability shall be pursued in accordance with the provisions of relevant laws and administrative regulations.

Article 12 An internet platform enterprise is not required to submit the tax-related information of operators and practitioners on the platform prior to the coming into force of these Provisions.
Where an overseas internet platform enterprise provides profit-making services within the territory of the People's Republic of China, it shall submit the tax-related information of operators and practitioners on the platform in accordance with the provisions of the competent tax authority under the State Council.
Article 13 The competent tax department of the State Council shall formulate implementing measures in accordance with these Provisions.
Article 14 These Provisions shall come into force as of the date of promulgation.
